review.reviewer: Codex implementation owner; prospective design self-review
review.decision: Keep scope cleanup eligible until the latest valid snapshot has actually been swept
review.notes: Exact #1930 third-head independent finding. Use the fake system center to hold an asynchronous read callback, then explicitly recover scope bytes. Exercise active isolation; no actual desktop mutation.

cases.description: A completed notification is withdrawn after the same verified snapshot recovers
cases.setup: Two delivered scope notices; Go removes one. Delay the OS delivered-list callback and make the snapshot unreadable when that callback runs.
cases.action: Restore byte-identical verified bytes and let the normal poll run without any new queued notice.
cases.expected: Unknown state does not clear either notice. Recovery retries cleanup and removes only the resolved notice. No extra alert is posted.
